semiconductor_relevance: High — RENA Technologies specializes in wet processing equipment essential for semiconductor wafer treatment, including etching, plating, and cleaning.
summary: RENA Technologies GmbH is a global leader in wet chemical equipment for the semiconductor industry, providing innovative solutions for wafer surface treatment. Their high-quality, customizable equipment supports various processes, ensuring optimal surface quality for semiconductor products.
capabilities: Advanced chemical etching solutions for SiC wafers
Fully automated processing platforms for 200 and 300 mm wafers
Semi-automated wet benches for multi-step processes

regional_presence.Europe: RENA has multiple manufacturing sites and innovation hubs across Europe.
